content_sections.heading: NIPER Hajipur Project Technical Support-III at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER), Hajipur

Hybrid Nanoarchitectures for Precision Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Therapy: Surface-Functionalized Lipid–Polymer Systems for Targeted Drug Delivery with Integrated Preclinical and Multi-Omics Validation (Project ID: IIRPSG(AN)-I-2026-01-00277)
Initial one year, extendable or curtailed; co-terminus with the project
Rs. 28,000.00 + HRA as applicable (current 10% HRA at NIPER Hajipur)
Maximum 35 years on the last date of application

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: NIPER Hajipur is described in the notice as an autonomous institution of national importance, established under the aegis of the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, Govt. of India, under the NIPER Act, 1998. The notice says it is recognized as a center of excellence in biological therapeutics and offers master's and doctoral degrees through research and development in pharmaceutical sciences. The post sits in the project of Dr. Vinod L. Gaikwad, Assistant Professor, Department of Pharmaceutics, who is the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from eligible and suitable Indian Nationals. The notice names the post on a contractual basis, purely on a temporary basis. The post is open to one UR candidate only. The qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University/Institute. For the discipline-specific eligibility, candidates should check the official notification. Preference will be given to candidates with a Pharmacy / Pharmaceutical Sciences / Pharmaceutics / Pharmacology / Pharmaceutical Analysis / Biotechnology / Life Sciences background. Experience in developing lipidic and polymeric nanocarriers, surface conjugation, physicochemical and solid-state characterization. Preference will be given to candidates with additional experience in in-silico studies, cell culture assays (preferably cancer cells), in-vivo animal experiments (preferably tumour-bearing models), multi-omics data generation and interpretation. Previous involvement in academic research projects and/or publications. The maximum age is 35 years on the last date of application, with relaxation to SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms. The notice does not print a minimum age.

rows.essential_qualification: Three-years graduate degree in Life/Health sciences field + three years post-qualification experience in the relevant subject/field, as required for the study of the Project concerned, from a Govt. and/or reputed institution/organization/research laboratory; OR post graduate (PG) degree in the Life/Health sciences field without professional experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 28,000.00 plus HRA as applicable; the notice gives the current HRA at NIPER Hajipur as 10%. The appointment is for an initial one-year term, which shall be extendable or curtailed, subject to requirement and performance review. The position is temporary and co-terminus with the project. Joining of the selected candidate is subject to the release of funds from ICMR. The selected candidate must adhere to all fellowship/service rules (terms and conditions) of ICMR and NIPER Hajipur, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: NIPER Hajipur Project Technical Support-III Job Description
content_sections.text: Implementing and executing research activities. Overall coordination and conduct of project activities. Maintenance of documentation (lab notebooks and records). Data analysis and report writing along with the study team.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIPER Hajipur Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Prepare a CV with a cover letter, together with scanned copies of the supporting documents listed below, in a single PDF file. Email the PDF to [email protected] and [email protected] . Mention the post name in the subject line of the email. Make sure the application reaches on or before 11-12-2026 (5:00 PM). Applications received after the last date will not be considered for shortlisting. Candidates already working under research schemes/projects should send their applications through the proper channel, along with an NOC from the current employer stating that they will be relieved immediately if selected. The notice says the documents are to be attached "but not limited to" this list. CV with cover letter Birth certificate / Proof of DOB Valid Photo ID and Address proof Certificate(s) of Academic Qualifications Experience Certificate (Work & Research) For SC/ST/OBC candidates: all community certificates (category, non-creamy layer and validity certificates, as applicable), issued by the authorized officers of the Govt. List of Scientific publications Any additional documents in support of candidature

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates (as per qualification, experience, merit and project requirements) will be notified through email to appear for an interview before the constituted committee. The interview date will be informed to shortlisted candidates through email. The interview will be conducted through Physical/Online mode. No TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The candidate should be flexible about travelling or staying to work at NIPER Hajipur. The selected candidate may be permitted to register as a full-time PhD student at NIPER Hajipur in the Pharmaceutics department, subject to the eligibility criteria and the applicable clauses/norms under the NIPER ordinance and NIPER-JEE at the time of admission. For further information or clarifications, applicants may contact the principal investigator by email at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIPER Hajipur Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: There is one post, Project Technical Support-III, and it is for an Unreserved (UR) candidate.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach on or before 11-12-2026 (5:00 PM). Applications received after the last date will not be considered for shortlisting.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: Either a three-years graduate degree in Life/Health sciences with three years' post-qualification experience in the relevant field, or a post graduate (PG) degree in the Life/Health sciences field without professional experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years on the last date of application, with relaxation to SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 28,000.00 plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 28,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states "Rs. 28,000.00 + HRA as applicable", and it gives the current HRA at NIPER Hajipur as 10%.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email your CV with a cover letter and scanned supporting documents in a single PDF file to [email protected] and [email protected], with the post name in the subject line.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted as per qualification, experience, merit and project requirements. Shortlisted candidates are informed by email and appear for an interview before the constituted committee, in Physical/Online mode.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary, project-based post under an ICMR-sponsored project, for an initial one-year term that may be extended or curtailed and is co-terminus with the project.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA given for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be given for attending the interview.
